title: Windows — Windshield Replacement by the Thicker Outer Ply Assembly with Relocated Heater Terminal
abstract: Replacement of a windshield pane by the thicker outer ply assembly with the heater terminal moved clear of the corner radius, normally accomplished at pane replacement rather than as a campaign.

sections.planning_reason: Delamination starting at the heater terminal in the lower forward corner has been reported on fifty-eight windshields in four years, almost all on the left-hand pane, and the removal rate has reached one per eleven thousand flight hours against a target of one per thirty thousand. Twenty-two removals were for delamination and the rest for crazing of the outer ply, traced to the same local heat concentration. Two events produced an electrical smell in flight and a diversion.
sections.description: The bulletin removes a windshield pane and installs the assembly with the thicker outer ply and the relocated heater terminal, replaces the retaining bracket, reworks the intercostal locally and re-routes the heater feed behind the side console.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Do the removal task AMM-C-56-10-11-000-019-A for the affected pane and support it clear of the aperture. Remove the bracket D5610112086631 and the outboard doubler ARD967927-47. Rework the intercostal D5610119127963 locally to the drawing D56101153469 to clear the relocated wiring and re-protect the machined area. Install the new bracket and re-drill the doubler to the new pattern. Install the pane using tension bolts AES273284K7 and blind rivets AES757493-5D and set the frame packing to the recorded shim value. Re-route the heater feed harness behind the side console in zones 211 and 213 and secure it clear of the reveal. Do the heater continuity and insulation check and record the values. Do the pressurisation leak check at the pane. Record the embodiment and the left and right standards fitted.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CIRRANE-11 and CIRRANE-13 aircraft from MSN C00071 to MSN C00479 that carry the delivered windshield assembly. Aircraft from MSN C00479 onward are already at the standard. Mixed left and right standards are permitted and must be recorded, because the frame packing differs.
sections.material_note: Kit K5610-2004-01 is supplied per pane and contains the assembly, the bracket, the fastener set and the shim pack. Lead time is thirty-four weeks, and the pane comes from a single source. The removed pane is returned for teardown for the first ten embodiments.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next replacement of the affected pane for any reason, and in any case within seventy-two months of the date of this Service Bulletin.
